The '''Dulfilvian system''', also known as the '''Filve system''', was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Filve]].

==History==
The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Dominant]]'' was assigned to the defense of the Dufilvian system following its commission. It was later reassigned to Filve's reserve fleet.<ref name="TTaBSb">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
